title: Find the distance
text: Integrate $$v(t)$$ with distance $$0$$ at $$t=0$$. With $$\frac{g m}{k}=245$$ and $$\frac{k}{m}=0.04$$, the distance is $$s(t)=245t-6125\left(1-e^{-0.04 t}\right)$$.

title: Solve numerically
text: Use a calculator to solve $$245t-6125\left(1-e^{-0.04 t}\right)=5000$$. The solution is about $$t=40.451$$ seconds.
